segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Since we last spoke we have grown a lot, so now we need to support 120,000 members.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: We also need single sign-on, and we have decided it must integrate with Okta specifically.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: We need a Stripe payment gateway integration as well.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: We'd like a more modern mobile experience but we are not sure yet what that means.

segments.speaker: Marcus
segments.text: For the newsletter, please use Mailchimp specifically as we already pay for it.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: We are not sure whether we still need the caching layer you suggested.
